prompt:
Edit the attached desktop dashboard approval mockup for Lojas Manu. Preserve its entire layout, dimensions, sidebar, existing logo image, white cards, typography, numbers, chart and all other content. Make ONLY these corrections in a single careful pass:
1) Top-right date must read exactly "sábado, 03 de outubro de 2026". October 3 2026 is Saturday. Preserve the connection indicator.
2) In the lower-right product ranking, all five light bar tracks must have equal width; blue fills must be proportional to the listed sales amount. Relative filled lengths: Sofá 3 lugares (R$6.000) 100%; Guarda-roupa 6 portas (R$4.800) 80%; Cama box casal (R$3.600) 60%; Mesa com 4 cadeiras (R$2.400) 40%; Painel para TV (R$1.650) 27.5%. Longest first, clearly decreasing. Keep names, furniture icons, prices and quantities.
3) Brand subtitle below "Lojas Manu" must say exactly "PDV Lojas Manu" instead of "PDV de teste".
4) Keep blue UI fills flat #0369a1 instead of gradients, and retain only hairline borders without decorative shadows.
Everything else stays fixed. This remains an approval mockup with the visible "Prévia visual · dados demonstrativos" notice; do not remove it. Do not invent new metrics, UI elements or alter numerical content.
sourcePrompt:
Generate one high-fidelity flat desktop application UI mockup, landscape 1600 by 1100, for the existing Brazilian furniture store point-of-sale application "Lojas Manu". This is an approval concept, not a functioning app. Preserve the existing app identity in reference image 1: blue #0369a1, white cards, background #f8fafc, dark #0f172a, muted #475569, light #e2e8f0 borders, clean Inter/Segoe UI typography, operational MUI controls and simple consistent line icons. Reference image 1 contributes only incumbent sidebar chrome, typography and palette, NOT its content, existing spacious rows or chart arrangement. Reference image 2 is the exact existing brand mascot/logo: place a small recognizable version beside "Lojas Manu" at the upper left, do not invent a replacement logo. No photography, gradients, glass, decorative furniture illustrations or browser/device frames.

STRUCTURE IS FIXED: sidebar about 225px; top white bar with single title "Visão geral"; right subtle green dot with "Conectado". Main work area starts at x250 with generous but efficient 24px spacing. The sidebar has readable icons and labels: Visão geral (active blue), PDV, Pedidos, Clientes, Produtos, Saídas Financeiras, Relatórios, Configurações; compact account and Sair at the bottom.

Under the top bar a single compact toolbar: left period select "Mês até hoje" with dropdown chevron; center short visible date comparison "01–03 out 2026 · comparação: 01–03 set 2026"; right outlined "Atualizar" and blue primary "Abrir PDV". Below it a compact amber-neutral label "Prévia visual · dados demonstrativos" and quiet context "Hoje: R$ 4.850,00 · dia em andamento".

A row of exactly four compact, individual white cards with 12px radius, hairline border, NO heavy shadows, equal widths. The cards show: "Vendas no período" R$ 18.450,00 with green small arrow "↑ 12,5% vs. período anterior"; "Vendas finalizadas" 12 with green "↑ 20,0% vs. período anterior"; "Ticket médio" R$ 1.537,50 with muted/red "↓ 6,3% vs. período anterior"; "Pedidos pendentes" 18 with muted label "Todos os atendimentos e períodos". Numeric totals are 29px high, highly legible, tabular, dark with blue for sales. Icons are small restrained outlined cash/order/ticket/time icons, not large badges. Keep green/red meaningful, include arrows and text, no fake sparklines.

FIRST CONTENT ROW has exactly two panels: large sales chart occupying 2/3 width and compact pending list occupying 1/3. Chart title "Evolução das vendas". Legend "Atual" solid blue bar swatch and "Anterior" gray dashed line swatch. Visible 3-day comparative chart matching dates Oct1–3: blue bars R$ 6.000, R$ 7.600, R$ 4.850; gray dashed previous line R$ 5.400, R$ 6.200, R$ 4.800. Currency y-axis R$0/R$4mil/R$8mil; x-axis 01 out,02 out,03 out. Enough whitespace and fine horizontal grid. Footer small link "Ver valores por dia" plus quiet help information icon for "Vendas finalizadas · data do pedido". Do NOT add another large sales total within the chart.

Right panel title "Pendentes para retomar" with small "Ver todos" action. Exactly five compact rows, oldest first: #5902 Ana Oliveira,28/09 · Venda,R$2.490,00; #5908 João Santos,29/09 · Orçamento,R$3.200,00; #5910 Carla Lima,30/09 · Venda,R$980,00; #5916 Pedro Souza,01/10 · Venda,R$1.750,00; #5918 Maria Costa,02/10 · Orçamento,R$2.100,00. Names and total strong, metadata small but readable, subtle amber pending indication, no overdue claims. Row separators light. Total pending count 18 is global while five shown.

SECOND ROW same 2/3+1/3 layout: left white "Pedidos recentes" panel with "Ver todos" action and five comfortably compact table rows. Columns Pedido/Cliente, Data/Tipo, Situação, Total. Show furniture customers in synthetic names, mix Pendente, Confirmado, Finalizado, status outlined subtle amber/blue/green badges. Align totals right. Include #5924 Beatriz Silva,03/10 · Venda,Finalizado,R$2.650,00; #5923 Marcos Rocha,03/10 · Venda,Finalizado,R$2.200,00; #5922 Luana Mendes,02/10 · Orçamento,Pendente,R$3.180,00; #5921 André Lima,02/10 · Venda,Confirmado,R$1.200,00; #5920 Clara Alves,02/10 · Venda,Finalizado,R$2.490,00.

Right panel title "Produtos com maior valor vendido", sublabel "Após descontos". Exactly five ranking rows, with furniture names, amount right, secondary quantities with unit, small true-to-value blue horizontal bars scaled proportionally: Sofá 3 lugares R$6.000,00,3 UN; Guarda-roupa 6 portas R$4.800,00,2 UN; Cama box casal R$3.600,00,3 UN; Mesa com 4 cadeiras R$2.400,00,2 UN; Painel para TV R$1.650,00,2 UN. These sum exactly R$18.450,00. Small chair/bed/storage line icons only by relevant item. No thumbnail images, progress rings or generic decorations.

Entire interface readable in one landscape image, compact but calm, polished production-feasible desktop operational software. Main title appears only in topbar. Visible short footer "Atualizado às 10:42 · Fortaleza" and quiet keyboard hint "PDV: Alt + Shift + V". All UI text in Brazilian Portuguese, no English marketing text. Preserve all specified fields, never invent margin, inventory, goals, conversion or delivery metrics.
notes: Mockup gerado; não é captura de funcionalidade implementada. A largura das barras no desktop não reproduz fielmente os valores; a implementação deve usar 100%, 80%, 60%, 40%, 27,5%, como no estudo móvel. Cores devem usar os tokens existentes, sem gradientes.
